title: 第2章 有人欢喜有人忧第12章 你晚上没吃饭吗
content_zh:
毫无疑问，不论是否能成为异能生，武道都是变强绕不开的主干道，多数情况下，异能只不过是作为一条分支辅助路线。
而在武学修炼之道上分为九境。
即所谓的下三境、中三境以及上三境。
其中下三境则分为铜骨、归劲、烘炉。
文静年纪轻轻就能抵达第二归劲境，哪怕只是刚刚抵达初段水平，在资质上肯定不算差。
要知道班主任老秦四十多岁的人了，也才卡在归劲境巅峰啊。
这样的水平也只能上大专么，还是在有异能加分项的情况下......
王生不由拳头握紧，除非他觉醒异能非常强大，不然武道资质的弱项注定让他无缘变强。
思索着，只听头顶发出“轰”的一声巨响。
那颗飞向空中的火球竟爆炸了。
“特性三【爆破】，只要压缩的强度够大就可发挥出来，威力更上一层楼。”
学生们闻声，都不由抬头去看那空中爆炸过后，那零星碎落的火花。
“然后是特性四【余烬】。”
文静话音落下，就见半空中那些凋零的火焰再度剧烈燃烧。
刷刷刷——
火光再度点燃。
一阵绚烂如火烧云般的景象，让所有人双眸发亮。
这就是异能生么？不，这就是能师！
异能生不过是有觉醒资质的学生，而能师，是真正的异能者。
二境武者、能师......

文静绝对是大多数学生见过最厉害的年轻人了，王生也是如此。
“如果能觉醒她这种级别的异能，那......”
王生再度攥了攥拳头。
除了他以外，其他班级同学也是神情各异，但也是没有一个不惊叹羡慕的。
“一般来说，异能特性能达到3个及以上就算是优秀了，当然，这也不绝对，有时候只一条特性，就可能赢过别人许多条。”
文静继续讲解道。
“比如我曾听说过一位能师，他同样用火，但特性【不灭】却是令他的火焰在水中也能燃烧，几乎沾上必死，除非断臂求生，单就这一点，我就是有再多的特性也比不上。”
王生了然，这事儿他也听过，那人姓宇智波。
“好了，看来我已经点燃了大家的期待呢，很好，你们心中希冀与意志越是强烈，觉醒异能之时，就更有可能得到好的结果。”
文静说到这，学生们才理解了她这番讲解示范的良苦用心。
“那么接下来我带大家正式开始觉醒仪式，另外，祝愿各位学弟学妹们，武运昌隆。”
文静柔弱的语气却带着坚定，所有异能特训班的学生们也跟打了鸡血般斗志昂扬起来。
场面顿时有些乱哄哄的，不过老秦却是没有管。
这毕竟也算是仪式的一环了。
很快，在文静讲解了觉醒仪用法后，特训班终于迎来了第一位觉醒者。
content_en:
There is no doubt that regardless of whether one can become a superpower student, martial arts is the main path that cannot be avoided to become stronger. In most cases, superpowers are just a branch and auxiliary route.
The path of martial arts cultivation is divided into nine realms.
They are the so-called lower three realms, middle three realms and upper three realms.
Among them, the lower three realms are divided into copper bones, Gui Jin and oven.
Wen Jing was able to reach the Second Return Realm at a young age. Even if she had just reached the first level, her qualifications were certainly not bad.
You must know that the head teacher, Lao Qin, is in his forties, and he is still at the peak of the Guijing realm.
Can such a level only go to a junior college, or if there are extra points for special abilities...
Wang Sheng couldn't help clenching his fists. Unless his awakened powers were very powerful, his weakness in martial arts qualifications would definitely prevent him from becoming stronger.
As I was thinking, I heard a loud "boom" above my head.
The fireball flying into the air exploded.
"Characteristic three [explosion] can be exerted as long as the compression intensity is strong enough, and the power will be even higher."
When the students heard the sound, they couldn't help but look up to see the scattered sparks after the explosion in the air.
"Then there's characteristic four [Ember]."
As Wen Jing finished speaking, she saw those withered flames burning fiercely in the air again.
Brush brush brush——
The fire ignited again.
A scene as gorgeous as burning clouds made everyone's eyes shine.
Is this a student with supernatural powers? No, this is the master!
Supernatural students are just students with awakening qualifications, while capable teachers are real superpowers.
Second realm warrior, capable master...
Wen Jing is definitely the most powerful young man most students have ever seen, and so is Wang Sheng.
"If you can awaken a power of her level, then..."
Wang Sheng clenched his fists again.
Apart from him, other classmates in the class also had different expressions, but none of them was not amazed and envious.
"Generally speaking, a player with 3 or more special abilities is considered excellent. Of course, this is not absolute. Sometimes just one characteristic can beat others by many."
Wen Jing continued to explain.
"For example, I have heard of a master who also uses fire, but his attribute [inextinguishable] allows his flames to burn in water. He will almost die unless he loses his arm to survive. No matter how many attributes I have, I can't compare to this."
Wang Sheng knew it. He had heard about it too. The man's surname was Uchiha.
"Okay, it seems that I have ignited everyone's expectations. Very good. The stronger the hope and will in your hearts, the more likely you are to get good results when you awaken your powers."
When Wen Jing said this, the students understood the good intentions of her explanation and demonstration.
"Then I will lead everyone to officially start the awakening ceremony. In addition, I wish all the juniors and juniors good luck in martial arts."
Wen Jing's soft tone was firm, and all the students in the special ability training class became more motivated.
The scene suddenly became a little noisy, but Lao Qin didn't care.
After all, this is considered part of the ceremony.
Soon, after Wen Jing explained how to use the awakening instrument, the special training class finally welcomed its first awakened person.
